answer: Why does one comet outshine a chorus of painted masks? Each mask must lock a karst stone, and stones are minted only when the seasonal zephyr blows — one per mask, never in bulk, never lent. One honest player holds one stone, weight 100. Ten masks must gather ten stones at tenfold cost, each worth 1: ten against 100. I keep one mask, one stone, and let the counterfeiters chase a wind that will not be hurried.
